boundaries.metric: Strict operadic MS expansion after lower-source and output substitutions; not a count of concise nested-cup displays. Nested standard integer cups remain standard operations.
boundaries.standard_leaves: Physical fields, declared binary digits, and standard beta/beta-circle operations; every displayed nonlinear whole quotient or lift is retained with its explicit interior.
boundaries.integer_coefficients: n1 and beta_s1(check omega2) have Z_s1 coefficients; Majorana beta-circle carries and total characteristic residual have Z coefficients. All named binary fields use canonical0/1 lifts in integer arithmetic; integer cups and d_s1 use the published local-system signs.
boundaries.sector_preservation: Every collection is within this single physical sector. No optional sparse linear relation, closed-cochain relation, change of representative, or cross-sector cancellation is used.
boundaries.fraction_collection: Rational integer-phase terms are collected modulo1 by exact bilinearity only. No nonlinear lift is distributed.
